gemini_plate_review.verdict: Plate is fern-like and its printed Cibotium barometz caption is consistent.

qwen_evidence_review.maker_verdict: The candidate distribution sentence was fully supported.
qwen_evidence_review.checker_verdict: The embedded text reading order was scrambled; page-image adjudication showed the north/south direction was reversed.
qwen_evidence_review.correction: Assam and southern China are the northern boundary; the range extends south to Formosa and the Malay region.
qwen_evidence_review.lesson: A generative reviewer cannot approve layout-damaged OCR without checking the page image.

qwen_9b_availability.restriction: Use for candidate extraction and JSON structuring; never self-approve layout-sensitive OCR.

independent_adjudication.checker: Gemini 3.5 Flash on PDF page image plus deterministic Codex inspection
independent_adjudication.result: The checker rejected the maker's reversed distribution direction and produced a source-consistent correction.
independent_adjudication.policy_added: Layout-damaged OCR claims require page-image adjudication before promotion.
